verdict.rationale: cubic supports event-triggered automation in a narrow, PR-review-specific sense: it auto-reviews new PRs, auto-approves PRs meeting policy, custom agents enforce rule-based review policies via cubic.yaml, and it learns from reactions/replies. This is rule-based automation triggered by PR events, but it is not a general-purpose 'define rules to trigger arbitrary actions on any event' system as an AI-native automation platform would offer. missing for 10: evidence of a general event/trigger framework beyond PR review (e.g., custom webhooks, non-PR events, arbitrary action chains), and independent verification that custom agent rules reliably trigger as configured.
